column1: # Every gold val and test form of geez-dataset (after the master audit and flagged-rows resolution). generate_synthetic_fixed.py leaves out every
# synthetic line whose surface_form is exactly one of these forms, and stops if this file is missing.

# Gold files: merho_ges_gold_val.jsonl sha256 f95460f9ed38ed0a48af44e783070b4dd6bbd1b1223be55c965e1759fc04066e, merho_ges_gold_test.jsonl sha256 3a7bb1bafa502222a6d2fb2ec257c6f47b420cfdcc1554d29b9121510d57ba61.
# One line per form of a row, rows with no root included. geez_form is one "/"-spelling of the cell with "(...)" notes
# dropped, as scripts/check_dataset.py loads it; cell is the geez_form field as written in the gold file.
# Key: split + record_id + row + variant. row = index of the row in the record's table_data, from 0 (as in
# merho_ges_gold_flagged_rows.tsv); variant = index of the spelling in the cell, from 0; source_row and source_variant
# are the row's own fields (empty when the row has none). root = the row's root, else the record's; empty = no root yet.
# 2,916 entries, 2,855 distinct forms; 204 entries have no root.
